jobs.occupation: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

• 
Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

• 
Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

• 
Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

• 
Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

• 
Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

• 
Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

• 
Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

• 
Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

• 
Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

• 
Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

• 
Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

• 
Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

• 
Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

• 
Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

• 
Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

• 
Demonstrated passion for driving positive change for customers and their businesses, coupled with a willingness to travel both professionally and personally.

Why Join Us?

• 
Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.

• 
Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.

• 
Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere

• 
Work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

• 
Experience a dynamic workplace where team spirit, joy, and productivity go hand in hand.

• 
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Career growth and professional development opportunities.

• 
A collaborative and inclusive work culture.

Workplace

Work from either our Copenhagen or Aalborg offices and have the chance to visit our Brisbane location. Join our global team spanning Denmark, Sweden, India, the US, and Australia.

How to Apply

For more details, please contact our People and Culture Team at hr@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

About Travel Operations A/S

At TravelOperations, we're not just about professionalism and ambition; we're about building an environment where every employee shines. Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions. Join us in reshaping the travel industry landscape, where responsiveness and innovation are our guiding stars.

Diversity and Inclusion

At our company, Diversity and Inclusion are core values. We welcome applicants of all genders, striving for a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us in building an inclusive future where diversity is celebrated as a strength

Job Title: Business Operations Coordinator

Company: Kern Hansen Erhvervsrengøring

Location: Fjeldhammervej 15 2610 Rødovre 

Employment Type: Full-time (160 hours per month)

About the Company

Kern Hansen Erhvervsrengøring (CVR: 25479947) is an established(we are operating from 2000) and quality driven commercial cleaning company based in Rodovre. We pride ourselves on delivering premium, reliable cleaning and maintenance services to a wide portfolio of corporate clients across the region. To support our continuous growth and ensure our exceptionally high service standards, we are looking for a structured and energetic Business Operations Coordinator to join our operational team.

About the Role

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and detail oriented Business Operations Coordinator. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the central link between our office, our valued client accounts, and our dedicated field teams. You will drive operational efficiency, ensure high-quality service delivery, and lead our field staff to success on a daily basis.

Key Responsibilities

* Operational Scheduling: Oversee and manage weekly and monthly staff shift scheduling to ensure optimal workforce distribution across all client locations.

* Quality Assurance Audits: Conduct systematic on-site inspections using established company checklists to guarantee that service delivery consistently meets our strict contractual standards.

* Team Leadership & Support: Act as the primary operational point of contact for field staff, effectively resolving daily issues and fostering collaborative teamwork.

* Performance Metrics & Reporting: Maintain meticulous records of team attendance, monitor job completion timelines, and report operational progress to management.

* Account Coordination: Manage client relationships, review service evaluation data, and maintain all corporate account and contract documentation.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Education: A relevant Bachelor’s degree (e.g., Business Management, Business Administration, or similar commercial fields).

* Skills: Strong organizational, planning, and interpersonal communication skills with a problem-solving mindset.

* Language: Fluency in professional English (both written and spoken) is required.

* IT Literacy: Solid proficiency in everyday computer tools, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and dedicated digital scheduling systems.

What We Offer

* A full-time position (160 hours per month ) in a dynamic, supportive work environment.

* A competitive salary package corresponding to Danish labor market standards.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and application to Kern@kernhansen.dk 

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.description:
OFFICE MANAGER WANTED FOR OUR OFFICE IN ØSTERBRO

Are you service-minded, organised, and the kind of person who keeps the office running smoothly – even when things get busy?

We are looking for a dedicated Office Manager for a permanent position at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen.

As our Office Manager, you will be a central part of our day-to-day operations and play an important role in ensuring that the office runs professionally and efficiently.

We operate a staffing agency where the pace can be fast. Phones are ringing, candidates are coming and going, and there are always people, appointments, and tasks that need to be coordinated.

That is why we are looking for someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working with people, and appreciates a varied working day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be responsible for the day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Daily office administration and coordination• Welcoming candidates, temporary workers, clients, and other visitors• Answering phone calls and emails• Managing calendars and coordinating meetings and interviews• Preparing meeting rooms and office facilities• Ordering office supplies, refreshments, and other necessities• Handling post, parcels, and deliveries• Liaising with suppliers and business partners• Providing practical support with the onboarding of new employees and temporary workers• Updating and maintaining administrative information and documents• Planning internal events and social activities• Handling administrative and practical ad hoc tasks

You will also be an important source of support for our consultants and management team, helping to create structure and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

WHO ARE YOU?

Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership of the office and wants to make a positive difference in the workplace.

You notice what needs to be done, take initiative, and make sure tasks are followed through from start to finish.

We imagine that you:

• Are organised and have a strong sense of overview• Are outgoing, positive, and service-minded• Take responsibility and are comfortable working independently• Enjoy working with people and communicate professionally• Are able to manage several tasks at the same time• Thrive in an environment where the day does not always go according to plan• Have good IT skills• Communicate confidently in Danish and preferably also in English• Contribute positively to the atmosphere and sense of community in the office

Previous experience as an Office Manager, receptionist, administrative coordinator, PA, or office assistant is an advantage. However, your personality, way of working, and willingness to take responsibility are just as important to us.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

You will have a permanent base at our office in Østerbro and become an important part of our internal team.

At the same time, we believe in flexibility and freedom with responsibility. Depending on your tasks and by prior agreement, there will therefore be an opportunity to work from home a few days per week. Tasks that require your physical presence will, of course, be carried out from our office in Østerbro.

With us, you can expect a working day filled with people, responsibility, and plenty of variety. There is a short path from idea to action, and you will have the opportunity to shape both your role and the way we run our office.

We offer:

• A permanent position based at our office in Østerbro• The opportunity to work from home a few days per week• Flexibility and freedom with responsibility• A central role with responsibility and influence• A varied working day• Close collaboration with both colleagues and management• An informal, fast-paced working environment• Opportunities for professional and personal development

Location: Østerbro, Copenhagen / opportunity to work from homePosition: Full-timeStart date: As soon as possible / by agreementSalary: Based on qualifications

COULD YOU BE THE PERSON WHO KEEPS OUR OFFICE RUNNING SMOOTHLY?

Send your CV and a short application to info@manora.dk.

Please tell us a little about yourself and why you could see yourself becoming part of our team.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

PLEASE NOTE: APPLICATIONS AND ENQUIRIES WILL ONLY BE ACCEPTED IN WRITING.
